Hi Daniel / Asha,

Thanks again for your time today — quick recap from our discovery and a suggested next steps list so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs (from call)
- Low-latency interactive recommendations for customer support routing (90% of traffic < 200ms target)
- Data residency in US East; PII protections and audit logs required
- Expected throughput: ~50 qps peak, 10 qps steady

What we showed
- Redwood inference architecture and how we hit 200ms median latency at similar traffic profiles
- Prefix caching and batching strategies that reduce per-token cost
- Security options: VPC Private control plane + KMS integration

Suggested next steps
1) Tech checkpoint: share logs / sample payloads if you want a quick capacity sketch (Jonas can help).
2) Pilot proposal: 6-week pilot on Dedicated with goals and KPIs — I'll draft the SOW.
3) Internal stakeholders: confirm legal / security contacts for SOC 2 questionnaire.

I've attached the discovery notes and the short demo recording. If this feels right, is the pilot something you could prioritize this quarter? If so, can we get a nod on budget/owner and a legal contact?

Attachments: [Attachment: Horizon-Discovery-Notes.pdf] [Attachment: Demo-recording-20260518.mp4]

Team —

Horizon Tech (Daniel, Asha) had discovery yesterday. I sent a recap and then a quick bump this morning — no response yet. Before I nudge again, want to align on messaging and ask for any redlines or escalation triggers. Key points:

- Their priority is latency and residency; they mentioned legal will review SOC 2.
- Budget is unclear; they said they'd "check internally".
- Pilot ask: 6-week Dedicated pilot with KPIs (latency <200ms, 99th pct SLA target).

Questions / asks for you all:
1) Jonas — anything specific you want in the pilot SOW or a red flag on the throughput target?
2) Monica — from CS/onsite standpoint, what's realistic for a 6-week ramp and who should own onboarding?
3) Vanessa / Vivek — if they stall, are we comfortable offering a small trial credit or a shorter pilot to de-risk? Any pricing guardrails?

Attachments: Horizon-Discovery-Notes.pdf (attached to original recap).

Plan I propose after your quick replies:
- If no reply by EOD tomorrow, I'll send a one-line re-engagement that (a) reminds them of the pilot option, (b) offers a 2-week technical spike as an alternate, and (c) asks for the legal contact.

Please reply with 1-line guidance — timeboxed ask.

Thanks,
Soojin

Thanks Soojin — quick notes from the infra side:

- Throughput target looks reasonable; we should size GPUs for the 90th/95th pct bursts rather than median. Recommend we call out peak qps and provide a burst policy in the SOW.
- For the pilot SOW, include a short acceptance test (3-hour synthetic run + sample real payloads) so we have objective pass/fail for latency.
- No blockers on residency; KMS integration is standard. If they have strict key rotation policies, flag it and we can scope a small engineering task.

My suggestion for next outreach: emphasize the 2-week tech spike as lower commitment and include the acceptance test language — that tends to convert stalled prospects.

-Jonas
